title: Recording with the Golden Gate Quartet
summary: Hall and Carl Kress made most of the quartet's Columbia dates.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: The Golden Gate Quartet, I used to work with them a lot. Carl Kress and I used to record for them for Columbia.
With the Golden Gate Quartet, and Jimmy Crawford -- Jimmy Crawford on drums. We made most of their dates.
Were you on Stalin Wasn't Stalin' Alone?
That was quite a number for them at that time.
